page.layout: One page of text, single column, with Hebrew headwords and Latin glosses; no marginal notes. Running head at top centre in Hebrew. Page number at top left. Hebrew catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: רָצָה Velle, Beneuolè velle, Benevolum esse, Gra-tum, Acceptum esse vel habere, Acquiescere, Beneplacitum habere, Delectari re aliqua. item, Perficere, Complere, Absoluere. Niphal נִרְצָה Acceptari, Acceptum, Acceptabile habere. Hiphil הִרְצָה Perficere. Hithpahel הִתְרַצָּה Benevolentiam conciliare sibi.
רָצַח Pihel רִצַּח Occidere, Interficere, & dicitur tantum de homine. Niphal נִרְצַח Occidi. Pyhal רֻצַּח Idem.
מִרְצָח m. Latro, Homicida: plur. מִרְצָחִים.
רִצְפָּה f. Pavimentum: item Pruna, Carbo plur. רְצָפִים Carbones.
רָצַץ Conterere, Confringere, Concutere. Niphal נָרוּץ Disrumpi, Confringi. Pihel רִצֵּץ & רָצַץ Conquassare. Hithpahel הִתְרֹצֵּץ Coll dere se.

page.notes: Hebrew and Latin headwords partly blurred; Hebrew vocalisation in several entries is uncertain and transcribed approximately. Some Latin glosses near the top are damaged and read with [?] where doubtful.
